India sets 212-run target for Pakistan in U-19 final after Sharma's batting storm

India batted Pakistan to set a target of 212 runs in the U-19 final. Abhishek Sharma was a key player, with the coverage noting his performance. The report also mentioned that Ishan and Vaibhav were outside the top 3 highest six-hitters, with Abhishek at number 2 in that category among the top 5 batters after the India-Pakistan final. Tilak Varma also contributed significantly to the batting effort.
